A '''high-resolution projection system''' was a device that contained an [[enhancement jewel]] and a [[Focusing lens/Legends|focusing lens]]. In [[23 ABY/Legends|23 ABY]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Lowbacca]] discovered such a device in the [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Temple]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] while [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenging]] for a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] to use in building his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The projection system had been left there by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Technician/Legends|technicians]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|war]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Lightsabers" />

==Behind the scenes==
The high-resolution projection system appeared in the [[1998]] young reader's novel ''[[Young Jedi Knights: Lightsabers]]'', which was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]] and [[Rebecca Moesta]] as the fourth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Young Jedi Knights]]'' series.<ref name="Lightsabers" />
